newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq rallies around semiconductor, tech stocks.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq rallies around semiconductor, tech stocks.

text.p: The Nasdaq market jumped sharply Tuesday, with the day-long rally prompted by big name semiconductor and high-tech stocks, traders said.
The Nasdaq composite index gained 16.08 points, or 1.0 percent, to close unofficially at 1621.53. Advancing issues beat declines six to five on volume of 591 million shares.
Intel Corp helped set the heady pace, gaining 2-15/16 to 99-11/16. Shares earlier in the session reached 100 for the first time since the company's two-for-one stock split in mid-July.
"When the tech market didn't sell off this morning, that was excuse enough and the big tech stocks jumped in and kept following through," one Wall Street trader said.
"The top 50 high-tech names led the whole rally. Momentum players put them into play and kept them going."
Texas Instruments Inc rose 4-3/4 to 129-1/2. Micron Technology Inc rose 4-14/16 to 56/7/16. Both shares reached new year highs during the session.
After the close, Cisco Systems Inc said its profit from operations rose 34 percent in the fourth quarter, matching Wall Street forecasts on strong sales.
